question: For sodium chlorate droplets at RH of about 33% and 28 C, by how many percentage points did the share of coffee-ring deposits change when the magnetic field was applied?
expect: +40 points: 40.0% zero field to 80% with the field (Table 3)
rendered:
From the text, the share of coffee-ring deposits at RH of about 33% and 28 C, without a magnetic field, is 50.0% (Table 3). When a magnetic field of (290 ± 5) mT was applied, the share of coffee-ring deposits increased to 57.1% (Table 3). 

The change in the share of coffee-ring deposits is 57.1% - 50.0% = 7.1% points.
